scope.statement: The ritual pack uses four bounded moments from the Ganguli Adi Parva opening—organisation, comprehension, teaching and onward recitation—while keeping the living Guru Purnima/Vyasa Purnima association separate and requesting the full epic context from its owner.
scope.time_scope: Local Ashadha Shukla Purnima; 2027 civil-date fixture 18 July
scope.source_expression_scope: Ganguli English Mahabharata expression, Adi Parva opening, retained lines 374-510

evidence_refs.claim_scope: Vyasa publishes detailed/abridged forms, considers teaching, teaches Suka and other disciples, and directs Vaisampayana's recitation.
Current public evidence for Vyasa Purnima, the teaching-guru/diksha-guru distinction and separate gurukula customs.
Bilingual timing, source-layer separation, consent-led gratitude, household/institution actions, child/financial/health safety and major variants.
